storefront.usage: Storefront marketing pages, massive hero statements, category headers

dashboard.usage: Customer Portal and Admin Panel KPIs, page titles, widget headers

body.family: font-mono or structured sans (IBM Plex Sans, Inter used SPARINGLY only for tabular data)
body.usage: Data tables, matrices, invoice lines, general descriptions

labels.usage: Table headers, overlines, status badges, tiny UI elements

base.background_dark: #0B101A (Deep Midnight Void - for reverse contrast sections)

accents.kinetic: #FF4500 (Electric Safety Orange - urgent actions: Pay, Submit Quote, Add to Cart)

storefront.glassmorphism: Crystal Glass style: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]
storefront.texture: Subtle noise overlay on dark hero sections (mix-blend-overlay opacity-20)
storefront.overlay: Hero images must use bg-black/30 to bg-black/40 MAX. Gradient overlays preferred: bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-black/20 to-transparent.

dashboards.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces. NO glassmorphism in the data-heavy Admin/Portal to prevent visual refraction.
dashboards.borders: Grid Borders (Technical Look). 1px border-slate-200. Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
dashboards.neumorphism: Avoided. Use sharp 1px strokes with subtle shadow-sm for interactive cards.

grids_layouts.storefront_hero: Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetrical. col-span-8 for main image, col-span-4 for intro text.
grids_layouts.dashboard_kpi: High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Items use h-full.
grids_layouts.catalog_matrix: Dense table layout for size/color matrix. sticky headers and first columns for easy mobile scrolling.
grids_layouts.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy for Storefront (p-8 to p-24). Dense packing for Admin (p-4 to p-6).
grids_layouts.mobile_first: Always start with grid-cols-1. Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile.

storefront.interactives: Shadcn components heavily restyled (stripped of default Vercel look).
storefront.marquee: Editorial Ribbon style. react-fast-marquee with brand partners, font-serif, slow drift.

admin_and_portal.structure: Shadcn heavily utilized. Data Table, Dialogs, Select, Tabs.
admin_and_portal.cards: Flat, rectangular, dense styles. 1px border, no heavy drop shadows.
admin_and_portal.forms: Shadcn Forms. Use floating labels or distinct uppercase overlines.
admin_and_portal.charts: Shadcn/Recharts for KPIs (Sales velocity, Quote conversion rates).

invoice_print.layout: @media print specifics. Hide nav, hide sidebars. Pure white background, black text. Strict table grid, IBM Plex Sans font. Page breaks avoided inside table rows.

motion.philosophy: Momentum over speed. Lenis smooth scrolling for Storefront.
motion.interactions: Hover states must lighten active state. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2. No transition: all.
motion.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use aria-hidden='true' for decorative motion.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='quote-submit-button', data-testid='color-matrix-input').
accessibility.focus: Explicit focus states with high contrast rings.

media.rules: Images must have contextual relevance. Main subject must be preserved. Never use placeholder URLs.

hero_warehouse.description: Large warehouse scale, use for B2B logistics / About Us section

fulfillment_boxes.description: Yellow plastic boxes, ideal for Order/Fulfillment feature highlights

model_black_suit.description: High-end B2B fashion catalog hero, sleek aesthetic

model_varsity.description: Youthful fashion catalog item, street-wear B2B segment

logistics_delivery.description: Handing over package, use for Customer Portal order success or Admin returns workflow

3d_libraries_and_steps.library: React Spring Parallax or Framer Motion
3d_libraries_and_steps.usage: Storefront only. Use simple 2.5D parallax for scrolling down the fashion lookbook and features. Do not overcomplicate with WebGL for B2B. Buyers prioritize speed.
steps: Wrap Storefront layout in Lenis provider for smooth scroll momentum.
Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform to map y-axis scroll to image y-offsets.

instructions_to_main_agent.phase_1_setup: Initialize Tailwind, configure custom fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, IBM Plex Sans). Set up React Router for three distinct layouts: / (Storefront), /portal (Customer), /admin (Admin).
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_2_storefront: Build high-impact landing page. Use Lenis for scroll. Implement AI Gemini Chat widget as a floating FAB using Lucide icons. Build catalog with product cards.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_3_catalog_matrix: Crucial B2B feature: On Product Detail Page, do not use standard dropdowns. Build a 2D matrix (Rows = Colors, Columns = Sizes) with number inputs for bulk adding to cart. Display Tier Pricing table clearly.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_4_admin_portal: Switch to technical layout. Sidebar nav, dense grids. Implement Quotes Kanban pipeline, Order data tables. Build the print-ready Invoice component triggered via window.print() and styled specifically with @media print.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_5_polish: Apply data-testid to everything. Ensure contrast is perfect. Implement Sonner toasts for all actions.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make it creative.
Dark colors look good independently. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align text. Use asymmetrical grids.
Create depth with layered elements and z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (Storefront header).
MUST NOT apply universal transition: all. Target specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor, Lucide, or Radix icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable on marketing pages.
